$comment: Visual scenes for the 13 key-art records (home, mode cards, loading, store, portal). Pure picture description: no titles, quotes, numbers or UI copy. A value is the scene string, or {scene, roster}: roster lists the NAMED fighters (content ids, or id:skin) that appear; run_xai.py sends a board of their real models (ref_board.py) as the reference image, and the sensitivity sign-off (_design/reviews/fixwaves/W2_art_signoff.md) names every painted figure to one of these ids. Unnamed figures, crowds and armies are not allowed. build_keyart_prompts.py puts each in front of the record's fixed style, figure and sensitivity tail.

home_feature.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Ervet, a tall lean woman knight in a heavy layered blue-grey scale mantle over chalk-white armour, a full chalk-white helm with a slit glass visor marked by a pale blue cross, a long translucent pale-blue glass greatsword; Ardit, a broad square knight in chalk-white and pale-blue plate, a flat-topped square helm with a narrow pale-blue glass visor band, a tall clear glass pavise shield with blue diamond studs on his left arm, a short spear; Marund, a short stout mason in a felt apron and leather, a wide round ironstone dome cap, a smooth carved walnut mask with a plain rounded carved beard, a gentle brow and narrow carved eye slits shaded under the cap brim (no teeth, tusks, spikes, fangs or horns on the mask), a heavy stone maul. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Wide cinematic key art of a fight, NOT a group portrait: on a broad carved pale-stone road across a colossal sundial valley at the long hour, Ervet lunges toward the right with her glass greatsword in a sweeping slash, Ardit braced a step behind her with his glass pavise raised, and Marund charges in from the right, facing them, his stone maul swinging up to meet her blade; bright shards of pale glass light and curling ink smoke burst where the weapons meet. Cool blue-white morning light from the left over tall pale chalk spires, warm amber evening light from the right over low dark ironstone domes. The left third of the frame is open road in soft calm shadow (no writing of any kind); the three fighters fill the right two thirds, large and readable.

home_tile_ranked_season.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character model: Burdam, a huge broad brawler in brown leather and wrapped felt, enormous stacked pale stone pauldrons on his left shoulder, a broad notched cleaver with blue diamond inlays carried over his shoulder. Paint a NEW scene with exactly this character, on-model (same build, pauldrons, cleaver and colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, and add no other people. Painted card illustration: Burdam with his back to the viewer, climbing up and away from us on a long flight of carved chalk steps toward a pale stone bell tower with one great bell on a bright sunlit summit; we see only his broad back, the huge stacked pauldrons and the cleaver resting on his shoulder; the light grows stronger with every step, a feeling of ascent and earned rank. No crosses or religious symbols on the tower. One clear focal subject seen from behind and below, filling the frame edge to edge, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

home_tile_almanac_teaser: Painted card illustration: a great closed book of carved pale stone pages resting on a lectern of pale wood, thin lines of morning light escaping between its pages, a sense of a season about to begin. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
home_tile_practice_tool: Painted card illustration: a quiet training yard on a stone terrace at dawn, wooden practice posts wrapped in cloth, an ash spear and a glass shield leaning on a wooden rack, soft cool morning light. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

home_tile_collection_highlight.scene: The reference sheet shows four real character models; paint ONLY their signature pieces as objects, never the characters themselves: Marund's wide round ironstone dome cap, Tunlan's very wide flat round lampshade hat with its small lantern, Ervet's long translucent pale-blue glass greatsword, and Vashil's chalk ring of seven small clear glass bells. Painted card illustration: a quiet collection hall of honed chalk walls and dark ironstone arches; the four pieces are displayed side by side on low pale stone plinths: the dome cap resting on a plinth, the lampshade hat lying flat on a plinth with its lantern set beside it, the glass greatsword lying across a low wooden cradle, and the bell ring lying flat on a folded cloth on a plinth. Nothing hangs from frames, no ropes, no gallows-like posts. Warm amber lamps on the right, cool glass windows on the left. Nobody in the hall: no people, no statues, no heads, no busts, no mannequins, no armour stands, no masks. One clear focal row of pieces filling the frame edge to edge, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.

mode_rift.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models, left to right: Rishal, a lean quick runner in pale grey-white armour, two hard gull-grey crest plates sweeping back from a blade-shaped glass visor, two reversed glass knives in his hands. Paint a NEW scene with exactly these characters, on-model (same helm, visor or mask, same weapon and silhouette, same colours), as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up, and add no other people. Vertical poster-like painting: Rishal seen from behind, small in the lower foreground on a chalk cliff edge, his gull-grey crest swept back in the wind, looking out over a colossal sundial valley seen from high above at the long hour: exactly three long carved pale roads run across the dial from its left rim to its right rim (a top road, a middle road through the centre, a bottom road), deep groves of rounded broadleaf trees between them, a shallow stream along the north-south noon line, a round pale stone seat at the centre, a tall pale glass belfry on the far left rim and a low warm amber-lit ironstone dome on the far right rim, cool light on the left rim and warm light on the right rim. The roads and the dial are completely empty: no armies, no marching figures, no other people anywhere, not even tiny distant ones; Rishal is the only person in the picture. A darker lower area for a title.

loading_map_bridge: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: the fallen stone shaft of a giant sundial needle lying across a deep blue misty gorge, a single paved road along its top from a cool glass arch on the left to a warm banded stone gate on the right, a crack across its middle glowing faintly, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_fray: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: a round honed basalt plate set into a sunlit valley floor at noon, ten carved hour-marks around its rim, a small lantern cart at the centre, motes of light drifting down, no shadows anywhere, pale festival terraces around it, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_rift: Wide painted fantasy panorama, high aerial view: an immense circular sundial carved in pale stone fills the whole valley floor, engraved hour-lines radiating from a round stone seat at its centre and a broad engraved ring around it; three wide paved stone roads cross the dial from left to right; dense groves of round broadleaf trees fill the spaces between the roads; a hard band of violet shadow and a shallow stream cut across the dial from top to bottom; a tall pale glass belfry stands on the far left rim and a low warm amber-lit dome on the far right rim; warm late light, epic scale, ancient and monumental, no modern elements, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.

store_banner.scene: The reference sheet shows the real character models in their alternate outfits, left to right: Ardit in the Chalkline outfit (ink-grey armour drawn over with white chalk line-work, flat-topped square helm with a glass visor band, clear glass pavise), Tunlan in the Noon Fair outfit (a painted paper lampshade hat in rose-lilac and chalk, a small lantern before her calm carved mask of natural unpainted wood with closed carved eyes and a soft closed mouth line (no painted lips, no grin), long lilac robe), and Ervet in the Lamplit outfit (walnut armour, a smoked amber lampresin greatsword with a small lamp cage on the pommel, full helm with a slit glass visor). Paint a NEW scene with exactly these three, on-model, as a hand-painted illustration; do not copy the sheet's layout, sky or flat ground, do not line them up stiffly, and add no other people. Wide painted banner: the three pose proudly side by side on a carved sundial terrace in warm late light, strong rim light, celebratory but restrained, showing off their outfits; the left third is an empty, calm stretch of terrace in soft shadow (no writing of any kind anywhere).
